title: Printed page did not appear
summary: Observe the existing printer display and queue. Do not change settings or retry printing.

nodes.prompt: Is the printer display currently lit?
Does the existing print queue show the expected document?

nodes.text: Share the recorded dark-display observation with local equipment support. This guide does not establish the cause or authorize a repair.
Share the recorded lit display and listed document with print-queue support. This guide does not establish the cause or authorize a retry.
Share the recorded lit display and absent document with application support. This guide does not establish whether a print request was sent.
